logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the four 99mTc complexes were evaluated by the partition coefficients (log P) between 1-octanol and phosphate buffer (0.025 mol/L, pH 7.4) according to the previously reported method.28 Briefly, the complex was mixed with an equal volume of the two phase. The mixture was vortexed for 3 min and then centrifuged at 10000 g for 5 min. From each phase, 0.1 mL of aliquot was pipetted and counted in a γ-counter. The partition coefficient, P, was calculated as the mean value of each counts per45 minute per milliliter of 1-octanol layer divided by that of the buffer. The final partition coefficient value was expressed as log P ± SD.
